subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: After resolving the conflict and proving the exact merged tree, should ClawSweeper adopt the centralized durable dispatcher, active-ledger ceiling, and sealed requeue authority as its production repair contract?
rationale: Source and regression coverage can establish mechanics, but they cannot choose the intended production liveness, overload-recovery, and privileged cross-workflow authority policy.

options.title: Resolve and adopt
options.body: Resolve the release-file conflict, validate the exact merged tree, and accept the centralized fail-closed operating contract.

options.title: Split the rollout
options.body: Separate durable routing, proof traversal, and requeue authority into smaller independently deployable changes.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Do not land this draft if maintainers reject the centralized liveness or authority model.

recommendation.title: Resolve and adopt
recommendation.body: Resolve the release-file conflict, validate the exact merged tree, and accept the centralized fail-closed operating contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged-history signal across the affected production repair automation and is best positioned to approve its operating contract.
